trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically the moment you have earned the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: finish the story, work through the activities, collectibles and combat trophies, then clean up 100% completion. Expect roughly 200 hours in total for the platinum (PowerPyx) at a difficulty of about 4 out of 10. Turn cheats off for the whole run: turning on a cheat disables trophies.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission of the game: play through it and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is part of the story, and mission replay covers it if anything goes wrong.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story progression only: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story progression only: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Unmissable. (The asterisks are in the official name itself.)

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story progression only: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story progression only: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the end of the campaign: play through to the credits and it pops. After the story ends you keep free roam of Leonida, so nothing is locked behind the finale — this is when the real cleanup for 100% begins (Push Square). Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a campaign mission, so it unlocks by playing through the story; mission replay covers it if you need a second try. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A campaign mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A campaign mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A campaign mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. A campaign mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A campaign mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Unmissable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the longest trophy in the set and the hardest (PowerPyx). After finishing the story, open Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion to see the full in-game checklist of what is left — story, activities, collectibles and more. Work through that checklist; the tracker in this guide mirrors it. It takes roughly 200 hours in total for the platinum, so treat this as the final cleanup stage.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total across Leonida (Push Square), so you need a little over half of them. Stunts are the jumps and ramps marked around the map: hit them in a fast car or bike, land them, and they count. Work through them while exploring — you will pass many of them naturally on the way to other trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once. There are nine activity types in total (KeenGamer): shooting range, fishing, arcade games, races, drone races, bowling, meditation and more. Sample one of each — you do not need to win or finish them, just try them — and the trophy pops. A good early-game trophy: do it while you are unlocking the map.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. There are 42 Shooting Range challenges in total (the official count). Visit a shooting range, pick a challenge, and keep practicing each weapon until you hit the gold-medal score. Take them one at a time and learn the recoil pattern for each weapon — gold is about accuracy, not speed.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (KeenGamer). Find each drone race spot around Leonida, enter the race and finish first. Learn the course on a practice run, then race it for the win — the drone handles differently from a car, so take the corners wide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races at different events and locations around Leonida — street races, circuit races and more — and win 20 distinct ones. Repeating the same race does not count twice, so keep moving to new events. A fast, well-handling car helps more than raw top speed on the twisty city circuits.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him: land more or bigger fish than he does before time runs out. Watch the line tension and reel in steadily — jerking the rod loses the fish. If you lose, challenge him again.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end. It does not matter which game you choose or how high you score — finishing one is enough.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands are the side missions marked for strangers across Leonida: meet Andy, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Unmissable once you start his strand.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger mission strand. Meet Kenton, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Unmissable once you start his strand.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger mission strand. Meet Billy, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Unmissable once you start his strand.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked on the map (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and more): each has a strand of several missions. Finish 8 full strands — you do not need to do every stranger in the game, just eight complete ones. This pairs naturally with the five stranger-finale trophies, so work the strands together.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger mission strand. Meet Randy, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Unmissable once you start his strand.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Meet Tyrone, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Unmissable once you start his strand.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (KeenGamer). THIS IS THE ONE TO WATCH: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only trophy that might be missable, so meditate at every spot as you find it — do not leave them for the endgame. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points around the map; stand on one and meditate, and it counts. Check them off in this tracker as you go so none slips past.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to track down one specific animal: follow the clues to its territory, track it quietly, and take it down with a clean shot. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind so it does not bolt before you are in range.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, bars, garages and out-of-the-way spots. Each set needs every card in it, so keep collecting until three sets are whole. Use this tracker to mark which sets you have finished; the cards stay collected even if you move on to other trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo/share feature: open it at a spot, snap the moment and it counts that location. Work through the map region by region — 100 sounds like a lot, but you will pass most spots naturally while exploring for other trophies. Only distinct locations count, so keep moving.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten (PowerPyx): driving, shooting, flying, exploration and more. You only need 50 of the 80, so skip the ones you hate and pick the groups you enjoy. Your progress is tracked in-game under Progress, so check there to see which groups are closest to done.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then lose the cops and escape. Cause enough chaos with your partner beside you until the wanted level hits four stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. A fast car and a quiet back road make the escape much easier than fighting it out.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving — the trick is to never let the wanted level drop to zero before the third robbery. Bring a fast getaway car and park it facing the road.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive or ride anything you find — cars, bikes, boats, planes — and each new model counts the first time you get in it. Cruise the city, the countryside and the docks to find variety; rare and special vehicles hide in specific spots, so explore everywhere. Your progress is tracked in-game.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus when a group of enemies is close together, then chain your shots — aim for headshots to drop them fast before the focus ends. A busy shootout with plenty of cover is the best place to try it; if you only get three or four, reload the checkpoint and try again.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Get to VCIA, grab a plane and take off without a flight plan or clearance — the trophy pops when you leave the airport airspace your own way. Expect a wanted level for trespassing, so be ready to fly low and fast once you are up.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and stir up trouble. Rhinos are military hardware: steal one from a base or find one during a high-wanted-level rampage, then drive it through the city. The trophy is about the tank itself, so just getting in and causing chaos in a Rhino is the way — and the army will come to you once you do.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Plan it like a quiet job: case the store, go in when it is empty, keep your weapon holstered until the last moment, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If a camera or a clerk spots you, the attempt is blown — leave, lose the heat, and try again with a better plan.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Banks are the big jobs: crack the vault, grab the cash and get away clean. You need five successful vault robberies in total, so plan each one — a fast car outside, a quiet route in, and no lingering once the alarm goes up. The five do not need to be in a row.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida: spot one, block it or force it to stop, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky bomb on the rear doors or a well-placed ram both work — pick the truck, not the traffic around it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail the whole map until every area is uncovered — the city, the beaches, the swamps, the countryside and the islands. Your map fills in as you go, so check it for blank patches and head for them. This pairs well with the vehicle and WAiNK trophies: explore with a purpose and several trophies progress at once.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to every gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own off-the-books operations — drug labs, chop shops, smuggling drops. Find one per gang, hit it and get away. You need one for each gang, so keep a list of which gangs you have already hit and work through the rest.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail and enjoy the view — the trophy pops once you are sitting with your drink and the ocean in front of you. It is a quiet moment trophy, so take it slow; it is one of the hidden ones, so it will not show on your list until it pops.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a car showroom, then floor it straight back out through the glass — the big, loud, cinematic exit is the point. Pick a showroom with a wide front window, get a fast car inside, and go. The trophy pops on the way out.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Head to the alley, rent a lane and play a full game — follow through on your throws and finish the game. You do not need a high score; completing the game at this specific alley is what counts.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership to its best. This is a partner milestone: play together, complete activities as a pair and raise your partnership standing until it hits its peak. It is one of the hidden trophies, so it will not show until it pops — keep playing with your partner and it will come.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice. At some point the game asks you to choose — pick a side, spare or confront, take one path over another — and this trophy pops when the choice is made. It is about the decision itself, not which option you pick, so choose the one that fits your playthrough. One of the hidden trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try. This one is about a do-over: fail at something, then come back and nail it the second time around. If you are stuck on a tough challenge, do not be afraid to fail once — the retry is part of the trophy. One of the hidden trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the strange event. Something odd is out there in Leonida — a sighting, a signal, a place that does not add up. Find it and see it through, and this trophy pops when the weirdness resolves. It is one of the hidden trophies, so explore the odd corners of the map and follow anything that looks out of place.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock them over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a group on foot and swing a melee weapon from the car — bowling them over as you pass. Line up a slow drive-by past a crowded sidewalk, time the swing, and the trophy pops when they go down like pins. A slow car and a clear run make it much easier than a fast one.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to clean them into spendable cash. Keep laundering as you earn — it adds up across the whole game, and $250,000 in cleaned bills is the target. Robberies feed this trophy, so it progresses alongside the heist trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, ammo, car upgrades — anything from any shop counts toward the total. It adds up across the whole game, so just play normally and shop as you go; by the late game you will have spent well over $100,000 without trying. Check your spending in the stats if you want to see how close you are.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property. There are 8 garages to purchase (Push Square), each with one parking spot. Save up and buy them one by one as you find them around Leonida — they are also useful for storing the vehicles you need for the vehicle trophies. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it. Do that for ten different vehicles. It pairs well with the vehicle-discovery trophy: as you find new rides, register the ones you like and both trophies move at once.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
